title: Atomic Increment
goal: Increment a shared atomic counter from a spawned thread.
hints: Atomic methods in Rust start with `fetch_` when performing math operations.
To read the value from a shared atomic reference, use `load`.
explanation: `fetch_add` atomically adds a value to the atomic integer through a shared reference `&AtomicI32` and returns the previous value. Method `add` does not exist on `AtomicI32` and causes compiler error `E0599`. `store` replaces the atomic value instead of adding to it, making the counter equal 1 instead of 6. Reading the value requires `load`. Method `get` does not exist on atomic types, and `into_inner` requires move ownership of the atomic variable, which fails behind an `Arc`.
